reports.info: Three senior students observed practicing forbidden summoning rituals in the eastern tower. Wards on floor 13 have been weakened. Recommend immediate surveillance escalation.

Campus perimeter glamours changed three times this week. New cloaking patterns don't match any known curriculum. Could be advanced student projects or deliberate obfuscation.
Quarterly supply order includes twice the usual amount of moonstone reagent. Likely preparation for spring exams, but flagged due to moonstone's dual-use potential.
